title: Touristic Eastern Express 2026–27: How to Plan the Ankara–Kars Sleeper Trip
excerpt: Season dates, the two different stopover routes and a booking checklist for the winter sleeper train between Ankara and Kars, with individual tickets released from 26 October 2026.

body.text: The Touristic Eastern Express (Turistik Doğu Ekspresi) has become one of Türkiye’s most talked-about winter journeys: a sleeper train from Ankara to Kars through snowy Anatolian landscapes, with planned sightseeing stops along the way. For the 2026–27 season the Transport Ministry announced 70 departures, and individual tickets go on sale through TCDD Taşımacılık’s channels from 26 October 2026. Compartments are limited, so the useful question is not whether the trip is beautiful, but how to plan it well before you start the booking form.
As reported by [DHA](https://www.dha.com.tr/gundem/turistik-dogu-ekspresi-yeni-sezonda-70-sefer-yapacak-2960568) on 11 October 2026, the season runs to these patterns:

items: Ankara to Kars: departures from 21 December 2026 to 10 March 2027, on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
Kars to Ankara: departures from 23 December 2026 to 12 March 2027, on Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays.
35 departures in each direction, 70 in total.
Sleeping cars with 10 two-berth compartments each, plus a dining car.
Individual ticket sales from 26 October 2026 through TCDD Taşımacılık’s sales channels.

body.text: The direction you choose changes what you see. Ankara–Kars trains make sightseeing stops in Erzincan and Erzurum. Kars–Ankara trains stop instead at İliç, Divriği and Sivas. Divriği is home to the Great Mosque and Hospital, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, which makes the return leg attractive for travellers interested in Seljuk-era architecture, while Erzurum suits those who want a larger city stop on the way east.

In the previous season the [ministry’s announcement](https://www.uab.gov.tr/haberler/turistik-dogu-ekspresi-yeni-sezona-hazir) described stops of about two and a half hours in Erzincan and four hours in Erzurum, with roughly three hours in İliç, two and a half in Divriği and three in Sivas, and a total journey of about 32 hours including stops. These figures describe the 2025–26 pattern; use them to imagine the rhythm of the trip, then confirm the current stop lengths before planning a meal or a visit at each station.

Last season the ministry noted that individual tickets were sold through TCDD Taşımacılık while tour packages were sold by authorised agencies. The two suit different travellers. An individual ticket gives you control over hotels in Kars and onward travel. A package can bundle transfers, guided stops and hotel nights, which helps if you do not speak Turkish or are short of planning time. Whichever you choose, check what is included at each stopover and keep a copy of the seller’s terms.

items: Decide your direction first, based on which stopovers you want to see.
Pick two or three acceptable departure dates before sales open, so you can move quickly if your first choice sells out.
Agree compartment sharing in advance; each compartment has two berths.
Enter every traveller’s details exactly as they appear on the travel document used for the journey.
Read the change and cancellation conditions shown for your purchase and save them with your confirmation.
Plan the other direction now: a return train, a flight from Kars, or a longer journey through eastern Türkiye.

body.text: Eastern Anatolia in midwinter is genuinely cold, and stopovers happen outdoors. Pack proper winter layers, waterproof shoes with grip, a power bank, some cash for small purchases at stops and any personal medicines you need in your cabin bag. Bring snacks and water for the long stretches between meals, and keep your passport or ID within reach. Book your first night in Kars or Ankara with a flexible check-in, since winter weather can shift arrival times.

If you are combining the train with the rest of Türkiye, our [winter travel guide](/blog/turkey-in-winter-premium-travel-guide) covers the off-season more broadly, and our [month-by-month guide](/blog/best-time-to-visit-turkiye-month-by-month) helps you fit the journey around other regions. To reach Ankara from Istanbul first, use our [Istanbul–Ankara high-speed train checklist](/blog/istanbul-ankara-yht-booking-checklist).

seo.uniqueValue: Compares the two directions by their stopovers, separates the confirmed 2026–27 calendar from last season’s stop durations, and gives a pre-sale booking checklist.

quality.reviewNotes: Prepared 2026-10-24. 2026–27 dates, weekdays, 70 trips, 10 two-berth compartments per car and 26 Oct sale start checked against DHA (11 Oct 2026). Stopover lengths, 32 h, agency packages taken from the Ministry 2025–26 announcement and explicitly labelled as last season. Divriği UNESCO status is long-established public record. No fares stated. Cover shows Ankara, the departure city, not the train. Independent review recorded in the daily ledger.
